title: Crossroads Inn
description: A fantasy waystation on a cobbled crossroads at the edge of the wilds, on a 440 x 300 mm base of 4 magnet-jointed tiles: a timber-framed inn, a leaning wizard's tower with an observatory dome, an open forge, a cage wagon with a lift-off roof and a 20 mm base socket, so its owl-beaked bear can be swapped for another beast, a well, quest board, signpost and two oaks (FDM), plus five 32 mm adventurers, a pony and small props for resin. Built with the scene workflow (Tripo pieces, Claude assembly). Not test printed yet.
material: White PLA and resin, hand painted

components.name: Ground tiles F1, F2, B1, B2
Minis, props and cage wagon (removable beast)
